name: List company attributes
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the definitions of custom attributes that exist for company objects, for example to display them in a UI or to validate data before creating or updating a company. Use the action that adds a new custom attribute for a company if you need to add a new attribute instead.

internalName.description: Internal name used by the system for the attribute.

group.description: Identifier of the attribute group this attribute belongs to.

attributeTypeName.description: Data type of the attribute (e.g., text, number, date).

isEditable.description: Whether the attribute can be edited by users.

label.description: Label shown in the UI for the attribute.

objectType.description: The object type this attribute applies to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attribute was created.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the attribute.

attributeOptions.description: Options for attributes that have predefined choices; null for free‑text attributes.

isValueReadonly.description: Whether the value of this attribute is read‑only.

oldInternalName.description: Previous internal name if the attribute was renamed.
